properties.name: Carlanna to Ward Lake
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. The longest gap on the downtown-to-Ward spine, crossing the benches between Carlanna Lake and the Ward drainage.
properties.whatItNeeds: A surveyed line, land-manager agreement (USFS, Borough, and any Trust parcels), and a funded design package.

properties.name: Connell to Lunch Creek
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. Continues the interior corridor from Connell Lake toward Lunch Creek so the north-island trails stop being isolated walk-ins.
properties.whatItNeeds: Survey, USFS review, and a decision on how the line meets existing Lunch Creek tread.

properties.name: Deer Mountain to Silvis
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. A ridge connection from Deer Mountain toward Silvis Lake. Showing this line is a planning statement, not a route description.
properties.whatItNeeds: A surveyed alpine alignment, a seasonal-use plan, and Forest Service agreement before anyone hangs flagging.
